correctness.rationale: The quotient is covered by explicit weight-one gauges x≠0 and u₁≠0. The former has affine-space quotient, the latter is a smooth hypersurface with boundary T=0, parametrized globally by Yʹ, B and units Uᵢ. Its normal bundle is trivial because T generates its ideal in an open neighborhood of the entire boundary. Integral divisor Gysin and self-intersection yield the torsion-free Betti groups and zero positive cup products, and transversality gives simple connectivity. Chow localization plus injectivity of divisor class via H² gives the full Chow ring. Stratification gives motivic class and field counts. The standalone exact finite-field checks pass but are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: The source provides a natural smooth generically flexible but nonflexible affine family with invariant divisor, motivating global topological and intersection-theoretic analysis. The complete torsion-free integral cohomology ring, square-zero multiplicative ideal, Chow ring, Hodge types and finite-field count are intrinsic family-level invariants; the distinction between increasing higher cohomology and vanishing higher Chow groups is substantive. The proof is a structural classification for all n≥1, not an arbitrary slice or a sample census.
